metadata.description: Funding opportunities for Bangladeshi CS/AI/ML students pursuing MSc/PhD abroad (2027-2029)
metadata.targetProfile: Bangladeshi student, CS/AI/ML/Data Science, seeking fully-funded or partially-funded graduate programs
metadata.criticalNote: PhD programs typically offer full funding; MSc funding highly competitive and varies by country. Apply to multiple funding sources simultaneously.

fundingOpportunities.fundingAvailability: Good for PhD, competitive for MSc

governmentScholarships.name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Very low, 5-10 awarded globally per year to developing countries

universityFunding.availability: High for PhD, medium for MSc
topFundedUniversities: University of Toronto - Vector Institute affiliates
universityFunding.fundingNote: Most PhD positions in AI/ML are funded if accepted by supervisor with active grants; MSc often requires self-funding or competitive scholarships

fundingOpportunities.livingStipendAdequacy: Tight in Toronto/Vancouver; adequate in Montreal/smaller cities
fundingOpportunities.workWhileStudying: 20 hours/week during term, full-time during breaks
fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: Apply for fully-funded PhD positions with AI labs; for MSc, target smaller universities with better funding ratios or plan partial self-funding with part-time work

fundingOpportunities.fundingAvailability: Excellent for PhD, very limited for MSc

universityFunding.availability: Very high for PhD, minimal for MSc

selfFundingCost.phdTotal: Rarely needed if admitted to top programs

typicalPackage.phd: EUR 2,500-3,500/month as research employee (TV-L E13 contract)

governmentScholarships.name: MEXT Scholarship (Japanese Government)
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Moderate - 30-50 Bangladeshi recipients/year across all fields

universityFunding.availability: Good with MEXT or university scholarships
universityFunding.fundingNote: MEXT is most comprehensive pathway; university RA positions also available; tuition ~JPY 535,800/year at national universities

fundingOpportunities.livingStipendAdequacy: Adequate in most cities; tight in Tokyo
fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: Apply for MEXT scholarship via embassy or university; high success rate for STEM. Even without MEXT, tuition reasonable and part-time work viable. Learn basic Japanese.

fundingSources: University scholarships (KAIST, SNU, POSTECH offer generous funding)
topFundedUniversities: KAIST - nearly all grad students funded
universityFunding.fundingNote: KAIST guarantees funding for all admitted PhD students; GKS is generous and includes Korean language training

fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: GKS is excellent comprehensive scholarship - apply via embassy. KAIST/SNU also offer direct admission with funding. Korean language requirement for GKS is 1 year training included.

governmentScholarships.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Very high - hundreds of Bangladeshi recipients annually

governmentScholarships.name: Confucius Institute Scholarship
governmentScholarships.amount: Full coverage for Chinese language + degree

universityFunding.availability: Very good especially at top universities
fundingSources: University scholarships (Tsinghua, Peking offer generous packages)
topFundedUniversities: Tsinghua University - excellent funding for AI
University of Science and Technology of China
universityFunding.fundingNote: CSC widely available; stipend covers basic living; top universities offer additional allowances; many programs taught in English

fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: CSC scholarship easiest to obtain among all countries - high acceptance rate for Bangladeshi students. Strong option for fully-funded study with good AI research, but consider long-term immigration limitations.
fundingOpportunities.criticalNote: Excellent for education and funding; weak for permanent immigration pathway

bestPhdFunding: USA top programs (88% chance, high stipend)
summaryComparison.strategicAdvice: PhD almost always funded at top programs - apply directly. MSc requires strategy: target Germany/Norway for low tuition, or China/Japan/Korea for government scholarships, or self-fund in expensive countries only if wealthy or planning high-salary jobs to recoup costs quickly.
